svg.title: Enhanced Graph Algorithms Visualization
svg.desc: Interactive demonstration of BFS, DFS, and Dijkstra's algorithm with path finding and shortest path calculations.
svg.text: Interactive demonstration of BFS, DFS, and Dijkstra's shortest path algorithms

g.text: BFS explores nodes level by level using a queue
Guarantees shortest path in unweighted graphs
DFS explores as far as possible using a stack
Good for topological sorting and cycle detection
Dijkstra finds shortest paths in weighted graphs
Uses priority queue to select minimum distance
Time: O((V + E) log V) | Space: O(V)
Path: A → B → C → F (3 steps)
Path: A → D → E → F (3 steps)
Shortest Path: A → B → E → F (Distance: 7)
• Social networks, web crawling, shortest path
Watch how different algorithms explore the graph to find paths from A to F
